prompt_templates.name: Standard Zero-Shot
prompt_templates.description: Directly asks the model to repair the vulnerability without providing examples or explicit reasoning.
prompt_templates.template:
You are a software security expert.

The following code contains a vulnerability.

Repair the vulnerability while preserving the original functionality.

Return the repaired code surrounded by <repaired_code> tags.

Code:
{code}

prompt_templates.name: Few-Shot Prompting

citation.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

prompt_templates.description: Provides one or more examples of vulnerable code and corresponding repairs before asking the model to repair the target program.

prompt_templates.name: Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought

citation.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

prompt_templates.description: Encourages the model to reason through the vulnerability before producing a repair.
prompt_templates.template:
You are a software security expert.

Analyze the vulnerability.

Let's think step by step.

After identifying the vulnerability, produce a corrected version of the code.

Return the repaired code surrounded by <repaired_code> tags.

Code:
{code}

prompt_templates.name: Plan-and-Solve

citation.title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting: Improving Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Reasoning by Large Language Models

prompt_templates.description: Separates reasoning into planning and execution stages before generating the repaired code.
prompt_templates.template:
You are a software security expert.

First, devise a plan for repairing the vulnerability.

Next, execute the plan.

Finally, produce the repaired code.

Return the repaired code surrounded by <repaired_code> tags.

Code:
{code}

prompt_templates.name: Security-Oriented Chain-of-Thought

citation.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting of Large Language Models for Discovering and Fixing Software Vulnerabilities

prompt_templates.description: Guides the model through security-specific reasoning prior to generating the repair.
prompt_templates.template:
You are a software security expert.

Reason about the vulnerability before repairing it.

1. Identify the vulnerability.
2. Identify the statements responsible.
3. Explain why the vulnerability occurs.
4. Determine what must change.
5. Produce the repaired code.

Return the repaired code surrounded by <repaired_code> tags.

Code:
{code}
